text:
mia: quick brain dump — what about a "role-band" + "audit swimlane" hybrid? role bands for scannability, and an audit swimlane that appears beneath a band when you hit the chevron. keeps context, lower nav jumps.

oliver: love the idea. swimlane = inline expansion rather than slide-over? curious about vertical space pressure on dense lists.

mia: yep inline swimlane. collapses to zero height when closed. we can show a condensed timeline (latest 6 events) and a link to full audit page. goal is fast peek without leaving list.

sam: product check: SSO is org-level only today. do we show an SSO indicator per-role? option: show a small read-only badge "SSO enforced" only when org SSO is on; otherwise hide. avoids disabled controls confusion.

design-bot: mock: https://figma.redwood/role-band-swimlane (band + swimlane + badge). badge variations: pill, icon+tooltip, or inline microcopy.

tess: accessibility checklist: 1) band should be a single focusable element (role=listitem, aria-label summarizing role name + members + top perms) 2) swimlane should be role=region with aria-labelledby linking back to the band 3) announce when swimlane opens (use aria-live polite) 4) on close return focus to the band chevron.

mia: dev note for performance: inline swimlane means row height changes — must integrate with VirtualList. Marco (cc) suggested an IntersectionObserver-driven approach to lazy-render timeline content to avoid layout thrash.

oliver: microcopy question: for the SSO badge tooltip, propose: "Organization SSO is enabled — all members must use SSO." shorter: "SSO required org-wide." Which do we prefer?

sam: prefer clarity: go with the longer one. also add an inline link in the tooltip: "Manage SSO" that opens org settings. make sure link opens in context, not a new tab.

tess: keyboard detail: if the badge includes a link, ensure it is reachable via Tab after expanding band, but not in the main band tab order if it's decorative. otherwise keyboard users will land on it unexpectedly. also ensure color contrast of the pill meets AA in both light/dark tokens.

design-bot: updated slices uploaded with contrast values and badge variants. added a condensed density that keeps hit targets 44x44.

mia: action items: design-bot — finalize three badge treatments + tooltip copy and contrast numbers; oliver — prototype swimlane lazy-render approach with VirtualList and measure reflow; tess — formalize SR aria-label templates and announce copy; sam — confirm product sign-off on read-only SSO badge. sync Friday 10am.

mia: thanks all, dropping this in #design-critiques in a bit :heart:
